name: NASA
body: GEO scores 91: answer crawlers are welcome, structured data names the organization, and pages carry authors and dates. Security headers are where it trails.
lesson: Four headers close most of that gap: Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy.
summary: www.nasa.gov scores 82 out of 100 (B). 2 checks fail now, 18 are at risk, and 22 pass. Fix first: 4 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 4 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /newsletters/, /events/, /event-type/launch-schedule/. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 11 structured data items miss a property Google expects
fix.evidence: / Organization lacks url, /news/ Organization lacks url, /news/recently-published/ Organization lacks url and 8 more.
fix.fix: Fill the missing properties so the item qualifies for rich results.

fix.title: 9 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /2026-news-releases/, /news/recently-published/, /nasa-blogs/, /event-type/launch-schedule/ and 5 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: X-Content-Type-Options is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers may guess a file's type and run it as script. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 586 ms
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
